
Add the missing script to `package.json`. For example, if the intended validator is a new script at `scripts/mjs/verify-template-markers.mjs`:
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "verify:template-markers": "node scripts/mjs/verify-template-markers.mjs"
  }
}
```

Then create the validator. A basic implementation could be:
```js
// scripts/mjs/verify-template-markers.mjs
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

const files = [
  "README.md",
  ".env.example"
];

const requiredMarkers = [
  "<!-- template:start -->",
  "<!-- template:end -->"
];

for (const file of files) {
  const contents = await readFile(file, "utf8");

  for (const marker of requiredMarkers) {
    if (!contents.includes(marker)) {
      throw new Error(`Missing marker "${marker}" in ${file}`);
    }
  }
}

console.log("Template markers verified.");
```

Adjust `files` and `requiredMarkers` to match the repository’s actual template-marker convention. Commit both changes and ensure the lockfile is unchanged unless dependencies are added.

If template-marker validation is no longer intended, the alternative fix is to remove `npm run verify:template-markers` from the workflow. Do not leave the workflow calling a nonexistent script.

The cache audit itself passed. The Node 20 deprecation notice is unrelated to this failure; the immediate exit code 1 is caused solely by the missing npm script. `package.json` is the appropriate place to add the missing command: [package.json](https://github.com/jggjosue/prompt-studio/blob/e9311f1f9987a2a5a104e39049b7dfe94521c5ad/package.json).

_**User (2026-09-16 19:37:13Z)**_

The job fails at the guardrail step because `quality.yml` runs an npm script that is not defined:
```text
npm error Missing script: "verify:template-markers"
```

The failing command is in [quality.yml lines 45–49](https://github.com/jggjosue/prompt-studio/blob/e9311f1f9987a2a5a104e39049b7dfe94521c5ad/.github/workflows/quality.yml#L45-L49):
```yaml
npm run verify:env-example
npm run cache:audit
npm run verify:template-markers
```

### Recommended fix

If template-marker validation is required, add the script to [package.json](https://github.com/jggjosue/prompt-studio/blob/e9311f1f9987a2a5a104e39049b7dfe94521c5ad/package.json):
```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "verify:template-markers": "node scripts/mjs/verify-template-markers.mjs"
  }
}
```

Then add `scripts/mjs/verify-template-markers.mjs` with the repository’s expected files and markers. For example:
```js
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

const files = ["README.md", ".env.example"];
const markers = [
  "<!-- template:start -->",
  "<!-- template:end -->"
];

for (const file of files) {
  const contents = await readFile(file, "utf8");

  for (const marker of markers) {
    if (!contents.includes(marker)) {
      throw new Error(`Missing "${marker}" in ${file}`);
    }
  }
}

console.log("Template markers verified.");
```

Use the actual template files and marker strings expected by the project rather than copying the example blindly.

If this check was added accidentally or is no longer needed, remove this line from the workflow instead:
```yaml
npm run verify:template-markers
```

The cache audit passed. The Node 20 deprecation message is only a warning and is not the cause of the failure. The coverage artifact upload is configured with `if: always()`, so it may also report an error when coverage was not produced, but the first required fix is the missing npm script.
